name: Fresh Canna Live Resin | Blue Dream
description: Step into a world of smooth euphoria with Fresh Canna’s Live Resin Wax – Blue Dream, a legendary sativa-leaning hybrid that delivers the perfect balance of relaxation and creativity. Made from fresh-frozen, top-shelf cannabis, this live resin wax preserves the full terpene and cannabinoid profile, ensuring a flavorful and potent experience with every dab. Expect a sweet berry aroma with hints of earthy pine, followed by a smooth, uplifting high that sparks creativity and mental clarity while keeping your body in a relaxed state of bliss. Whether you’re tackling a creative project or just looking to unwind, Blue Dream is your ticket to a dreamy, elevated state.
